title: OnlySolverz
tagline: A crosschain visualization dashboard for the only swaps network
description: This is a dashboard to understand crosschain swaps for the only swaps network. Crosschain swaps are usually hard to track as they involve analysing multiple chains at once and associating token transfers with each other. Therefore, only solvers helps mitigate this problem by analysing all events and transactions for the router contract on each chain that it is deployed to (Ethereum, Base, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Filecoin, Scroll) and presents them in a manner that is clear to understand.
how_its_made: This projects uses the Envio indexer to pull the all past events and transactions for the only swaps router on each chain that it is deployed to (Ethereum, Base, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Filecoin, Scroll) and stores all of them in a hosted PostgreSQL database provided by Envio. The frontend is built using Next.js.
